fullDescription: A complete, copy-ready button design system on one calm reference page: six semantic variants (primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, icon-only) across three sizes (small 32px, default 40px, large 48px) and five interaction states (default, hover, active, disabled, loading). A sticky frosted nav and emerald hero open onto five labeled sections (variant lineup + token strip, an anatomy grid showing rest/hover/active per variant, a sizes band, a five-state strip, and an icon-button + icon+label block). White canvas with a faint dotted grid, slate ink text, a single emerald #10b981 accent, Inter, and Iconify Lucide icons; reflows cleanly to mobile.

structured.summary: A complete, copy-ready button design system laid out on one calm, full-bleed reference page: six semantic variants (primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, icon-only) rendered across three sizes (small 32px, default 40px, large 48px) and five interaction states (default, hover, active, disabled, loading). The page opens with a sticky frosted nav and an emerald hero ('Every button, every state, on one calm canvas.'), then walks through five labeled sections: a variant lineup showcase with a token strip, an anatomy grid where each variant shows rest/hover/active side by side, a sizes band, a five-state strip, and an icons section (square icon-only toolbar buttons plus icon+label combos). Built on white with a faint dotted grid, slate ink text, and a single emerald accent (#10b981), on Inter with Iconify Lucide icons; it reflows cleanly to tablet and mobile. The library value is the transferable button token system and the section-by-section anatomy layout.

style.description: A calm, premium, modern-SaaS aesthetic for documenting a component system. The canvas is white (#ffffff) overlaid with a very faint 28px dotted/line grid (slate at ~3.5% opacity) so demo surfaces read as a design canvas. Text is slate ink: near-black #0f172a for headings, slate #64748b for body, light slate #94a3b8 for tiny uppercase cell labels. A single emerald accent (#10b981, deepening to #059669 on hover and #047857 on active) carries every primary/brand moment; rose (#e11d48) is reserved strictly for the destructive variant. Surfaces are soft and airy: cards use rounded corners (rounded-xl to rounded-2xl), hairline slate borders (#e2e8f0 / slate-100), and gentle layered shadows (0 1px 2px plus a wide -12px spread at ~8% opacity). Buttons share a 10px (0.625rem) radius, 600 weight labels, a 160ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) transition, and a 3px emerald focus ring (rgba(16,185,129,.35)). The mood is restrained and documentation-grade: lots of whitespace, tiny uppercase tracked labels, monospace token chips, and the emerald reserved so the system reads calm rather than loud. Typography is Inter throughout (400/500/600/700/800), with extrabold for the hero and bold for section H2s.
style.prompt: Use a calm modern-SaaS design system on the Tailwind CDN with these EXACT custom tokens. Ink (slate) scale: 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a, 950 #020617. Emerald accent scale: 50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 200 #a7f3d0, 300 #6ee7b7, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981, 600 #059669, 700 #047857, 800 #065f46. Body is `bg-white text-ink-900 font-sans antialiased`. Font (Google Fonts): Inter, weights 400/500/600/700/800, set as the `sans` family with `ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif` fallbacks, plus `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility`. Add a `.grid-bg` canvas backdrop = white with two 1px linear-gradients (`rgba(15,23,42,0.035)` to right and to bottom) at `background-size: 28px 28px`. Define a single shared `.btn` primitive: `inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5rem; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:0.625rem (10px); transition: all .16s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; user-select:none; outline:none`, with `:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(16,185,129,.35) }`. Tiny labels use `.cell-label` (`font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#94a3b8`) and token chips use `.chip-mono` (`font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace`). Reserve emerald for primary/brand moments only and rose #e11d48 strictly for destructive; everything else is white, slate ink, and hairline slate borders. Icons are Iconify Lucide. Keep generous whitespace and the page documentation-grade and calm.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column documentation page: a `sticky top-0 z-50` frosted white nav (`bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md` over a `border-b border-ink-200/70`) with a logo lockup, anchor links (Showcase/Variants/Sizes/States/Icons), a version chip, and a 'Copy tokens' primary button; a full-bleed grid-bg hero band with a pill badge, the extrabold headline 'Every button, every state, on one calm canvas.', a subhead, two hero CTAs, and a feature checklist; then a centered `max-w-[1180px] px-6` main holding five `border-b` sections (01 Showcase = variant lineup + token strip; 02 Anatomy = a 3-col grid of variant cards each showing Rest/Hover/Active; 03 Sizes = a 3-col band of Small/Default/Large; 04 States = a 5-col strip Default/Hover/Active/Disabled/Loading; 05 Icons = a 2-col block of an icon-only toolbar and icon+label combos); and a full-bleed dark (ink-950) footer band. Every section opens with a tiny emerald uppercase eyebrow ('NN · Label' with a Lucide icon), a bold H2, and a one-line slate subhead. Demo surfaces sit on the `.grid-bg` canvas inside rounded hairline-bordered cards.

prompts.prompt: Build a `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md">` with an inner `mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-[1180px] items-center justify-between px-6` row. Left: a logo lockup = an `h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-ink-900 text-white` tile holding a `lucide:square-mouse-pointer` (width 18), beside a two-line label ('Emerald UI' in `text-[15px] font-bold tracking-tight` over 'Component System' in `text-[11px] font-medium text-ink-400 -mt-0.5`). Center (md:flex, hidden below): a nav of five `text-[13.5px] font-medium text-ink-500 hover:text-ink-900` anchor links Showcase/Variants/Sizes/States/Icons pointing at the section ids. Right: a hidden-on-mobile `.chip-mono` version chip (`rounded-md border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-ink-500` reading 'v2.4.0') + a `.btn .btn-md .btn-primary` 'Copy tokens' button with a `lucide:copy` icon (width 15).

A `.grid-bg relative overflow-hidden border-b border-ink-200/70` section with a pointer-events-none `-right-24 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-emerald-300/25 blur-3xl` glow, and a `relative mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 py-16 sm:py-20` inner. Stack: a pill badge (`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-emerald-700` with a `h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500` dot) reading 'Button — design system reference'; an `mt-5 max-w-3xl text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight text-ink-900` H1 'Every button, every state, on one calm canvas.' (line-break after 'state,'); an `mt-4 max-w-xl text-[15.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-500` subhead; an `mt-7 flex flex-wrap gap-3` CTA row of a `.btn .btn-lg .btn-primary` 'Browse the grid' (lucide:layout-grid) + a `.btn .btn-lg .btn-outline` 'View tokens' (lucide:code-xml); and an `mt-9 flex flex-wrap gap-x-7 gap-y-2 text-[13px] text-ink-500` checklist of four items (6 variants / 3 sizes / 5 states / Icon + label combos), each prefixed with an emerald `lucide:check`.

A `#showcase border-b border-ink-100 py-14 sm:py-16` section. Header: an emerald eyebrow `flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-600` ('01 · Variants' with `lucide:square-stack`), a `text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-900` H2 'The variant lineup', and a `text-[14px] text-ink-500` subhead. Body: a `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white` card with a layered shadow `0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.08)`. Inside, a `.grid-bg flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 px-7 py-12` row of all six `.btn .btn-md` variants (Primary, Secondary, Outline, Ghost, Destructive, and an Outline 'Link' with a `lucide:arrow-right`). Beneath, a `border-t border-ink-200 bg-ink-50/60 px-7 py-3.5` token strip of `.chip-mono` chips: '--accent #10b981' (hex in emerald-600), 'radius 10px', 'duration 160ms'.

A `#variants border-b border-ink-100 py-14 sm:py-16` section with an '02 · Anatomy' eyebrow (`lucide:grid-3x3`), an H2 'Each variant, up close', and a subhead. Body: a `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4` of six `rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-5` cards (Primary, Secondary, Outline, Ghost, Destructive, Icon-only). Each card header is a `flex items-center justify-between` row of a `text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-800` name + a `.chip-mono` class chip (e.g. `.btn-primary` on emerald-50/700, others on ink-100/600, destructive on rose-50/700). Below, a `space-y-3` stack of three rows each = a `.cell-label w-12` ('Rest'/'Hover'/'Active') beside the same button rendered in that state via helper classes `.is-hover` and `.is-active`. The Icon-only card instead shows Primary/Outline/Ghost `.btn-icon-md` square icon buttons (lucide:plus, lucide:settings, lucide:more-horizontal).

A `#sizes border-b border-ink-100 py-14 sm:py-16` section with a '03 · Sizes' eyebrow (`lucide:ruler`), an H2 'From compact to prominent', and a subhead. Body: a `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white` card containing a `.grid-bg grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 divide-y divide-ink-200/70 sm:divide-x sm:divide-y-0` of three columns, each a `flex flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-12`: 'Small · 32px' (two `.btn-sm` buttons primary+outline), 'Default · 40px' (two `.btn-md`), 'Large · 48px' (two `.btn-lg`), each column topped with a `.cell-label`.

A `#states border-b border-ink-100 py-14 sm:py-16` section with a '04 · States' eyebrow (`lucide:activity`), an H2 'Five interaction states', and a subhead. Body: a `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white` card holding a `.grid-bg grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-px bg-ink-200/70` strip (the 1px gap + ink-200 bg create hairline dividers). Each of the five cells is a `flex flex-col items-center gap-3 bg-white px-4 py-10` with a `.cell-label` and a `.btn .btn-md .btn-primary` 'Save changes' rendered in: Default, Hover (`.is-hover`), Active (`.is-active`), Disabled (`.is-disabled`), and Loading (`.is-disabled` with a `lucide:loader-2` icon carrying a `.spin` keyframe animation and the label 'Saving').

A `#icons py-14 sm:py-16` section (no bottom border) with a '05 · Icons' eyebrow (`lucide:shapes`), an H2 'Icon buttons & icon + label', and a subhead. Body: a `grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4` of two `rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white` cards, each with a `border-b border-ink-200 bg-ink-50/60 px-5 py-3` caption header. Card A 'Icon-only · toolbar': a `.grid-bg flex flex-wrap gap-3 px-6 py-10` of `.btn-icon-sm`/`.btn-icon-md`/`.btn-icon-lg` square buttons (bold/italic/underline outline, then plus primary + search/bell ghost, then share/trash outline+destructive), separated by `h-7 w-px bg-ink-200` dividers. Card B 'Label + leading icon': a `.grid-bg flex flex-wrap gap-3 px-6 py-10` of `.btn-md` buttons with leading Lucide icons (New branch / Export / Generate / Filter) plus a trailing-icon 'Continue' outline button.

Close with a `border-t border-ink-200 bg-ink-950 text-ink-300` footer: a `mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 py-10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-6` row of a left lockup (an `h-7 w-7 rounded-md bg-emerald-500 text-white` tile with `lucide:square-mouse-pointer` + 'Emerald UI · Button System' in `text-white`) and a right cluster of a `.chip-mono text-ink-400` 'Inter · slate · #10b981' chip + a slate caption. Responsive: the centered nav links are `hidden md:flex` and the version chip is `hidden sm:inline`; the anatomy grid steps 1 -> 2 -> 3 columns (`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`); the sizes band stacks 1 -> 3 columns with the divider switching from horizontal to vertical; the states strip stacks 1 -> 5 columns; the icons block is 1 -> 2 columns; the hero scales `text-4xl sm:text-5xl`; nothing overflows at 390px.

special_ui_components.prompt: Define one base `.btn` (`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5rem; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; border-radius:0.625rem; transition: all .16s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; outline:none`) and compose every button from it with: size classes `.btn-sm` (h-2rem/32px, px-.75rem, text-.8125rem), `.btn-md` (h-2.5rem/40px, px-1rem, text-.875rem), `.btn-lg` (h-3rem/48px, px-1.375rem, text-1rem), and square `.btn-icon-sm/md/lg` (matching heights, equal width, padding 0); variant classes `.btn-primary/.btn-secondary/.btn-outline/.btn-ghost/.btn-destructive`; and forced-state helper classes `.is-hover/.is-active/.is-disabled` that mirror the real `:hover/:active/:disabled` rules so the documentation grid can render every state statically.

`.btn-primary` = `background:#10b981; color:#fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(5,150,105,.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12)`. Hover (`:hover` and `.is-hover`): `background:#059669; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(5,150,105,.30)`. Active (`:active` and `.is-active`): `background:#047857; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(4,90,70,.4); transform: translateY(.5px)`. All `.btn` share `:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(16,185,129,.35) }` (a 3px emerald focus ring).

Secondary = solid ink (`#0f172a` -> hover `#1e293b` -> active `#334155`, white text). Outline = `bg-#fff color-#0f172a border-#e2e8f0`, hover `bg-#f8fafc border-#cbd5e1 color-#047857`, active `bg-#f1f5f9 border-#10b981`. Ghost = transparent / `color-#334155`, hover `bg-#f1f5f9 color-#0f172a`, active `bg-#e2e8f0`. Destructive = rose `#e11d48` -> hover `#be123c` -> active `#9f1239`, white text. Disabled (`:disabled` and `.is-disabled`, applies to all) = `opacity:.45; pointer-events:none; box-shadow:none; transform:none`. Icon-only variants reuse the variant fills with the `.btn-icon-*` square sizing.

The loading button is a disabled `.btn .btn-md .btn-primary .is-disabled` containing a `lucide:loader-2` Iconify icon (width 16) given a `.spin` class = `animation: spin .8s linear infinite` with `@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg) } }`, followed by the label 'Saving', to show an async in-flight state.

Demo surfaces sit on `.grid-bg` (white + two 1px linear-gradients at `rgba(15,23,42,0.035)`, `background-size: 28px 28px`) so buttons read as if on a design canvas. Token values are shown in `.chip-mono` chips (`font-family: ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace`), e.g. '--accent #10b981' with the hex in emerald-600, 'radius 10px', 'duration 160ms', and the `.btn-*` class names labelling each anatomy card.

Every section opens with a `flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-600` eyebrow reading 'NN · Label' (01 Variants / 02 Anatomy / 03 Sizes / 04 States / 05 Icons) led by a small Lucide icon (square-stack / grid-3x3 / ruler / activity / shapes), above a `text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-900` H2 and a `text-[14px] text-ink-500` one-line subhead.

structured.special_notes: Exact color tokens (Tailwind config). Ink/slate scale: 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a, 950 #020617. Emerald scale: 50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 200 #a7f3d0, 300 #6ee7b7, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981, 600 #059669, 700 #047857, 800 #065f46. Rose for destructive: #e11d48 -> #be123c -> #9f1239. Font: Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800) as the `sans` family with system fallbacks, antialiased. Icons: Iconify Lucide (lucide:square-mouse-pointer, copy, layout-grid, code-xml, check, square-stack, arrow-right, grid-3x3, plus, settings, more-horizontal, ruler, activity, loader-2, shapes, bold, italic, underline, search, bell, share-2, trash-2, git-branch, download, sparkles, filter). Button tokens: radius 0.625rem (10px), 600 weight, transition `all .16s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`, focus ring `0 0 0 3px rgba(16,185,129,.35)`. Sizes: sm 32px, md/default 40px, lg 48px (icon variants are equal-width squares at the same heights). Single `.btn` primitive composes variant + size + state classes; `.is-hover/.is-active/.is-disabled` helpers mirror the real pseudo-states so the static documentation grid can show every state. `.grid-bg` = white + two 1px linear-gradients at rgba(15,23,42,0.035), background-size 28px 28px. `.cell-label` = .6875rem/600/uppercase/.04em tracking/#94a3b8; `.chip-mono` = ui-monospace. Layout: a sticky `top-0 z-50` frosted nav (bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md over border-ink-200/70), a full-bleed grid-bg hero, a centered `mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6` main of five border-separated sections (Showcase/Anatomy/Sizes/States/Icons), and a full-bleed ink-950 footer. Emerald is reserved for primary/brand moments; rose only for destructive; everything else is white, slate ink, and hairline slate borders. Built with the Tailwind CDN + Iconify. The prompt-library value is the transferable button token system plus the section-by-section anatomy layout for documenting any component set.
